3. Stuck: try r6c1

What-if
  1. Suppose a cat sits on r6c1. It crosses out its row, column, colour and neighbours.
  2. Common attack from pink. Every cell where its cat could still go attacks r3c4, r3c5, r3c6, r3c9, r3c10, so cross those out.

  5. Contradiction: green has no cell left. So r6c1 cannot hold a cat: cross it out.
